title: After the Elections
question: Why did Patrick keep on asking the same question?

meanings.usage: 用于指某人或某物过去的状态或职位
在选举、比赛或战争中击败对手
指政治职位的投票选举
指从工作或政治生涯中退出
与政府、政治活动相关的
指去往或身处其他国家
形容对某事物极度热衷甚至不理智
指比赛或政治中的竞争者
对某事或某人感到不信任
指建筑物或场所的入口处

phrases.usage: 继续做某事，反复做某事

examples.en: He kept on asking the same question.
examples.zh: 他不断问同样的问题。

examples.en: Mr. Lane has gone abroad.
examples.zh: Lane先生已经出国了。

examples.en: The policeman lost his temper.
examples.zh: 警察发脾气了。

examples.en: The day after, Patrick went to the house again.
examples.zh: 第二天，Patrick又去了那所房子。

examples.en: On the following day Patrick went to the house again.
examples.zh: 第二天Patrick又去了那所房子。

examples.en: He has gone to live abroad.
examples.zh: 他已经去国外居住了。

examples.en: Mr. Lane was defeated in the recent elections.
examples.zh: Lane先生在最近的选举中败北了。

examples.en: He is retiring from political life.
examples.zh: 他即将退出政坛。

sentences.en: The former Prime Minister, Mr. Wentworth Lane, was defeated in the recent elections.
sentences.zh: 前首相温特沃斯·莱恩先生在最近的选举中失利。

sentences.en: He is now retiring from political life and has gone abroad.
sentences.zh: 他现在正退出政坛，并且已经出国了。

sentences.en: My friend, Patrick, has always been a fanatical opponent of Mr. Lane's Radical Progressive Party.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友帕特里克一直是莱恩先生激进进步党的狂热反对者。

sentences.en: After the elections, Patrick went to the former Prime Minister's house.
sentences.zh: 选举结束后，帕特里克去了前首相的家。

sentences.en: When he asked if Mr. Lane lived there, the policeman on duty told him that since his defeat, the ex-Prime Minister had gone abroad.
sentences.zh: 当他问莱恩先生是否住在那儿时，值班警察告诉他，自从失利后，这位前首相就出国了。

sentences.en: On the following day Patrick went to the house again.
sentences.zh: 第二天，帕特里克又去了那所房子。

sentences.en: The same policeman was just walking slowly past the entrance, when Patrick asked the same question.
sentences.zh: 还是那个警察，他正慢慢地走过入口，这时帕特里克又问了同样的问题。

sentences.en: Though a little suspicious this time the policeman gave him the same answer.
sentences.zh: 尽管这次有些怀疑，警察还是给了他同样的答案。

sentences.en: The day after, Patrick went to the house once more and asked exactly the same question.
sentences.zh: 第二天，帕特里克又一次去了那所房子，问了完全相同的问题。

sentences.en: This time, the policeman lost his temper.
'I told you yesterday and the day before yesterday,' he shouted,
sentences.zh: “我昨天和前天都告诉你了，”他喊道，

sentences.en: He has retired from political life and gone to live abroad!'
sentences.zh: 他已经退出政坛并出国定居了！”

sentences.en: 'I know,' answered Patrick,' but I love to hear you say it!'
sentences.zh: “我知道，”帕特里克回答说，“但我喜欢听你说！”

grammar.title: 一般过去时 (Past Simple Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示过去发生的动作或存在的状态
grammar.usage: 描述过去发生的事情，如已完成的选举结果、去过的地点等

examples.en: Patrick went to the former Prime Minister's house.
examples.zh: Patrick去了前首相的家。

examples.en: The policeman told him that Mr. Lane had gone abroad.
examples.zh: 警察告诉他Lane先生已经出国了。

grammar.title: 过去进行时 (Past Continuous Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示过去某一时刻正在进行的动作
grammar.usage: 描述过去正在发生的动作，通常与一般过去时连用

examples.en: The policeman was just walking slowly past the entrance.
examples.zh: 警察正慢慢走过门口。

examples.en: While I was reading, the phone rang.
examples.zh: 我正在看书时，电话响了。

grammar.title: 直接引语和间接引语 (Direct and Indirect Speech)
grammar.definition: 直接引用原话为直接引语；转述别人的话为间接引语
grammar.structure: 直接引语用引号；间接引语用that引导
grammar.usage: 转述他人说的话时使用，过去时态中时间状语需要相应调整

examples.en: 'Mr. Lane was defeated in the elections,' he shouted.
examples.zh: 他在喊：'Lane先生在选举中败北了。'

examples.en: He told me that Mr. Lane had been defeated in the elections.
examples.zh: 他告诉我Lane先生在选举中败北了。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + was/were + 动词-ing when + 主语 + 动词过去式

original.zh: 警察正慢慢走过门口时，Patrick问了同样的问题。

examples.en: I was reading a book when the doorbell rang.
examples.zh: 我正在看书时门铃响了。

examples.zh: 我到家时她正在做晚饭。

original.en: I told you yesterday and the day before yesterday.
original.zh: 我昨天和前天都告诉你了。

examples.en: I told you many times to be careful.
examples.zh: 我告诉过你很多次要小心。

examples.en: I told you he would come late.
examples.zh: 我告诉过你他会迟到。

original.en: I know, but I love to hear you say it!
original.zh: 我知道，但我就是爱听你说！

examples.en: I know it's expensive, but it's worth it.
examples.zh: 我知道这很贵，但值得。

examples.en: I know you're busy, but could you help me?
